name.ja: バトルピカちんキット04ピカちんノットリガー

description.ja: なんでもノットルおそろしいヤツ、ピカちんノットリガー襲来！
description.en: Pikachin Nottrigger, the scary guy who can do anything, attacks!

description.ja: • ノットリギミックが既存のピカちんキットと強烈に連動！いろんなピカちんキットを乗っ取って、イタズラしまくるぞ！
description.en: • The knot gimmick works strongly with the existing Pikachin Kit! I'll hijack various Pikachin Kits and play pranks on them!

description.ja: • 全高約200mm。手回しでギミックを作動できるほか、別売りのピカちんトリガーと合体すれば電動パワーをゲットできる！
description.en: • Overall height approximately 200mm. In addition to being able to operate the gimmick by hand, you can also get electric power by combining it with the separately sold Pikachin trigger!

description.ja: • 「ゲーム貯金箱連動顔パーツ」「ケシカスイーパー連動顔パーツ」「エア臭ター連動顔パーツ」など顔パーツ４種付属。
description.en: • Four types of face parts are included, including "face parts linked to the game piggy bank ", " face parts linked to the poppy sweeper ", and " face parts linked to the air odor".
